task_instance: Given a small sample of monthly churn/MRR data and a 90-day engagement-cohort table (CSV inputs a user would supply), produce the skill's core deliverable: a data-driven narrative report that turns the numbers into a persuasive story, following the Problem-Solution framework and narrative arc from the skill (hook -> context -> problem -> insight -> solution -> expected impact -> call to action), supported by an annotated visualization.
evidence: Work dir real2_work/r277. Created two sample input CSVs (churn_data.csv: 6 months of new/churned/active customers and MRR; cohort_day90.csv: engaged-vs-not-engaged 90-day churn). Wrote build_story.py which (1) computed metrics from the data: monthly churn rate rose 3.8%->5.4% vs 5% benchmark, 760 churned over two quarters, engaged-first-14-days cohort churned 10% vs 45% for non-engaged = 4.5x, annualized loss ~=$7.3M, est savings ~=$4.1M; (2) rendered an annotated line chart churn_story_chart.png (1100x550 PNG, verified with file and PIL) using the skill's details.md annotation technique (ax.annotate arrow, axhline benchmark, bold title); (3) wrote data_story.md following the skill's Problem-Solution framework with a number+impact headline, hook, context, problem, insight, solution, expected impact, and call to action. Verified by running `python3 build_story.py` (printed computed numbers and 'report written'), inspecting data_story.md (coherent narrative with all narrative-arc sections and data embedded), and confirming the chart PNG dimensions. Deliverable is a complete, data-grounded story report plus supporting visual produced entirely from the sample data. No network, connector, MCP, or credential use; all work inside the work directory; used the machine's existing Python/matplotlib without installing anything.
